name: Federation Identity Model — Handles and Profiles
description: Define federation identity: DID-based handles, profile schema, follow/subscribe model, project membership, public/private visibility, activity feed schema, federation boundaries, and portable reputation encoding.
purpose: Define the identity and social graph model for federated Tribunus instances.
acceptanceCriteria: Identity model supports DID-based handles and profiles
Project membership and visibility boundaries specified
Federation boundary contract: what crosses instances, what stays local
Portable reputation encoding for cross-instance trust signals
